subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ27 across its XJ X308, XK X100 applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ26 and AJ27 are found across the XJ XJ8 (X308) and XK XK8/XKR (X100). The supercharged AJ27S is also present in XKR models, carrying additional ancillaries.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain components, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild. Supercharger components are also inspected on AJ27S applications.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The AJ26 and AJ27 are known for timing chain tensioner failure - plastic tensioners fail, and primary guides crack and break off, with pieces ending up in the sump. Early engines also suffered from Nikasil cylinder lining issues with high-sulphur fuel; later engines (from around 2002) use cast-iron linings. We inspect the timing chain system thoroughly on every rebuild and assess cylinder bore condition as part of the strip-down process.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ27 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ27 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine - illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ27's timing chain system is a known critical wear point on early AJ-V8 engines (1997-2000), with plastic chain tensioners failing and primary guides cracking and breaking off. We inspect the timing chain tensioners and guides thoroughly on every rebuild. Supercharged AJ27S variants (XKR) require additional specialist attention to the supercharger system. Full engine replacements require DME software matching.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain components, bearings, gaskets, plus supercharger inspection on AJ27S applications

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
